What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Bow To The First Order]]: left, the image of [[Bow To The First Order]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Bow To The First Order (Errata)]] (holotable commit 8190af8). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
